## Why it matters internationally

The Raman Lab descends directly from the experiments that made daytime
radiative sky cooling real, and now leads on directional and spectral
control of thermal emission. It anchors the engineered-emissivity tier:
emissivity treated not as a property to measure but as a design
variable.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** spectral and directional emissivity (engineered) · radiative cooling performance
- **Spectral range:** solar and sky-window (8–13 µm) bands
- **Methodology:** Radiative sky cooling (lineage of the first daytime demonstration); spectral and directional emissivity control via gradient epsilon-near-zero structures; broadband directional thermal emission.

**Application domains:** passive radiative cooling · thermal photonics.
